evidence_snippets: Widespread flooding across Cumbria and other parts of northern Britain in December 2015.
caused by record-breaking rainfall at the beginning of the month.
left over 5,000 homes inundated and 43,000 homes without power; local businesses badly affected.
missing_information: Exact event day(s) in December 2015 not stated
Impacts not disaggregated specifically for Cumbria versus wider region
